status: Research and sizing experiments only; no integration behavior, installed files or settings changed.
question: Which correction addresses oversized notification events and phone requests while preserving exact issue membership and replay?
recommendation: Use a byte-bounded human summary and a short authenticated link to a durable record of the exact delivered membership. Preserve full issue evidence through existing investigation workflows and a bounded read-only report lookup. Treat event compatibility and very large membership as explicit design work before implementation.

live_observation.method: Invoke the public read-only homeostatic.inventory action through the signed-in HA UI, then inspect its observed WebSocket result through the browser developer network capability. No stored snapshot was queried.
limits: These are reconstructions from current retained public member records, not captured historical outgoing payloads. The exact earlier failed request remains uncorrelated.
Estimates use compact UTF-8 JSON, a synthetic delivery id and representative phone tag/target lengths. Exact Python serialization was separately exercised with synthetic data.
The phone-service object is not the final APNs or FCM envelope. Provider wrapping, action buttons, critical and silent options need their own budget.
The public inventory returned no Homeostatic delivery_failures. Core Mobile App catches and logs remote send errors internally, so that empty list does not prove provider success.
Household names, account names, message contents, device identifiers and destinations are omitted from this research record.

verified_limits.behavior: Oversized serialized event data is replaced with an empty object in Recorder; live event subscribers retain their event data.
APNs rejects oversized regular notification payloads.
Both notification and data message types have a 4096-byte payload maximum.

code_findings.finding: The issue message joins every finding without a byte bound.
Grouped reports join every member's title and message, with new/outstanding and age text, without a byte bound.
The notification URL serializes every included issue id. The phone service request carries that URL in both url and clickAction.
The published payload removes _alerting but may retain _target_channels. Removing that internal field is insufficient to solve report text and URL growth.
The existing durable phone-action registry demonstrates exact membership correlation. Reports skip acknowledgment actions, and the current registry is not a report-link resolver.
The optional consumer blueprint independently builds the same long membership URL and sends the event message. Fixing only the built-in sender leaves that consumer path unchanged.
The resolved-request cache is process memory, bounded to 2000 entries. It cannot by itself support links that survive restart.

synthetic_validation.result: Passed sizing and Recorder behavior probes through current DeliveryState.record, notification_url and async_send functions. Every notification service was mocked; no live notifications were requested.
synthetic_validation.library: Published health-tree 0.11.0 installed only into an ignored research dependency directory. The unrelated existing virtual environment still has health-tree 0.6.0 and was not synchronized.
synthetic_validation.scope: Short text and short links are sizing experiments. A durable report resolver, production formatter and transport budget have not been implemented.

alternatives.option: Short summary plus a durable short report link
alternatives.assessment: Recommended. Addresses both text growth and repeated links while retaining one logical notification. Exact membership belongs in the retained report, and links must remain authenticated.
Insufficient. The observed 221-member reconstruction still produces an estimated 17679-byte phone-service request with a 1000-byte message.

alternatives.option: Split a large report into multiple phone alerts
alternatives.assessment: Possible fallback, but creates more alerts and requires stable part tags, frozen membership and cleanup across partial recovery and restart. Supersedes the accepted one-combined-request presentation and is not the preferred household outcome.

alternatives.option: Exclude events from Recorder or suppress the warning
alternatives.assessment: A logging workaround that deliberately gives up audit data and leaves oversized phone content unchanged.

alternatives.option: Raise Recorder's limit or compress notification content
alternatives.assessment: Does not address the smaller remote-push limit or ordinary readable notification rendering; changing Core's constant is outside the adapter correction.

implementation_constraints: Keep detection, audience resolution, collection deadlines, notification schedules and independent policy assignments unchanged. Initial work is owned by the Homeostatic presentation and delivery boundary.
Measure encoded bytes for the complete payload, including title, URLs, buttons, critical/silent options and provider overhead. A character-count limit or a 32 KB phone-message limit is insufficient.
Keep complete findings in issue queries. Mark summarized messages explicitly and retain counts and a route to the exact included report.

A short link must resolve frozen membership for that particular delivery, not current membership under a mutable group tag. Later arrivals must not appear in an old delivered scope. Reuse stable delivery identity and normal HA authorization; a reference is not a bearer credential.

Persist any new report-reference data with a bounded retention policy and validate upgrade and repeat-reload preservation. Preserve stored choices, edits, accepted destinations, pending delivery identities and old notification links.
Do not acknowledge omitted or unseen issues from a short preview. Existing reports already omit phone acknowledgment; collected immediate messages need an explicit preview/action rule.
Update the built-in sender and the shipped optional consumer blueprint together. Consumer automations that construct their own links need a documented compact-link field or lookup contract.

Retain exact machine membership for existing events wherever it fits. The 1000-member probe demonstrates that message summarization alone cannot guarantee the 32 KB Recorder bound while schema 1 requires an unbounded exact episodes array. A fully bounded reference-based event contract requires an explicit version and compatibility decision; never silently truncate episodes or change them to mean only the preview.

The current event reference promises one summary line per issue. Reconcile that documentation with bounded human summaries and the accepted concise-message workflow before dependent implementation. Do not silently repurpose a published field.

Verify direct and optional consumer delivery with mocked services, Unicode byte boundaries, one unusually large finding, large memberships, exact click-through, acknowledgment scope, partial recovery, silent replacement, final cleanup, pending replay, restart and failed persistence. Existing settings and destinations remain unchanged.
remaining_uncertainty: The earlier phone-delivery error is not proven to be caused by size. Current report reconstruction and isolated probes demonstrate the structural size problem independently; a real-provider outcome would require a separate authorized delivery trial.
publication: No commit, push, release or deployment.
